info.title: Card Shoe API — proposed contract
info.description: PLANNING DRAFT: endpoints are not implemented. See implementation-plan.md for confirmed behavior and remaining proposals. Mock responses are stateless examples, not game behavior. JSON request objects reject unknown fields, missing/null fields and invalid types; no numeric coercion. Errors use the ErrorResponse schema with a stable code. Unknown routes return 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND. In-memory storage remains a proposal.

post.description: Attach an unassigned deck to this game shoe. A deck belongs to at most one shoe, and a shoe belongs to one game. Assignment is atomic; attached decks cannot be removed. Duplicate or cross-game attachment returns 409 DECK_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.

post.description: Atomically deal min(count, remaining cards). Return dealtCards as the number actually dealt and remainingCards as the undealt count after the operation. Requesting 13 with 10 remaining returns {dealtCards:10, remainingCards:0}. An empty shoe returns both counts as zero.
